description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order to amend Regulations "D" made by the Monetary Board, published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1805/39 (Motor Vehicles)
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to banking regulations (Regulation "D" on Reserve Requirements) made by the Monetary Board under the Monetary Law Act. It involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to financial institutions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories that would take precedence over Type 5.
